items.editor_note: Adds the economic angle: the framework behind DeepSeek's high-margin inference.

editorial.tldr: This thread pairs an Oct 18 research item on LLM inference over mixed hardware with DeepSeek's Oct 20 DeepInfer release. Only the DeepInfer coverage is one story; the first item shares words, not an event.
editorial.whats_new: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer on Oct 20, the inference framework behind its production services; The Information (Oct 21) ties it to the company's high-margin inference.
editorial.why_it_matters: DeepInfer is the serving stack DeepSeek runs in production, so its scheduling and memory choices are a reference for anyone self-hosting large open-weight models, not a research demo.
editorial.take_for_builders: Read the DeepInfer repo's supported-hardware and model lists before planning a migration from vLLM or SGLang; wait for an independent throughput comparison on your own GPUs.

status.detail: DeepInfer is public; no independent benchmark or adoption report is in this thread yet.
